candidate.identitySemantics: Official HCAD documentation defines HCAD_NUM as an HCAD account number (the prior GIS help calls it a unique real-property account number). It defines LOWPARCELI/LOWPARCELID as an account-number enumeration used to tie multiple accounts to one polygon, and Stacked as indicating a polygon contains multiple accounts. The current layer has seven HCAD_NUM duplicate groups; full group reads show each has two rows. Four pairs have disjoint geometry and three pairs have exactly identical geometry, with no partial-overlap pairs. All seven pairs agree on acct_num and on tax-year/status/site reference fields; six also agree on LOWPARCELID, one varies. The three exact-geometry duplicate pairs are the same groups where Stacked varies. These observations support HCAD_NUM as the account-level canonical unit and geometry union/deduplication; do not require disjointness. LOWPARCELID and Stacked are unsuitable partMatchFields.
candidate.possibleFilter: Use attributeNotNull=[HCAD_NUM] to avoid synthesizing identities. Both HCAD_NUM-null rows were also null for LOWPARCELID and acct_num, so they have no published parcel/account key. The non-null HCAD_NUM inventory has seven duplicate groups, all fully inspected.

suggestedDescriptorIfResolved.partMatchFieldsCaveat: acct_num was invariant within all seven observed duplicate groups and is the only extra account reference required for this integration.
suggestedDescriptorIfResolved.disjointPartsRationale: The runtime skips overlap testing when component GeoJSON is exactly equal; the three exact duplicate pairs are therefore deduplicated. The other four observed pairs are disjoint. True rejects any future non-identical overlapping components.

latestAttempt.method: Browser-like Chrome User-Agent, Accept and Accept-Language; ArcGIS statistics query (groupByFieldsForStatistics=HCAD_NUM, count OBJECTID, HAVING count>1) followed by complete HCAD_NUM IN queries for all observed duplicate account IDs. Requested only identity, account grouping, year/status/site/admin fields and geometry; no owner or mailing fields. Geometries and account IDs remained in memory and were not saved.
latestAttempt.geometryMethod: ArcGIS f=geoJSON, outSR=4326. Turf 6.5 intersection and area were evaluated on all complete account pairs. Identical geometry pairs have positive intersection area; the other four pairs have zero intersection area. No partial-overlap pair was observed.

officialSemantics.observation: Official current GIS help defines HCAD_NUM as HCAD account number; LOWPARCELI as account-number enumeration/account number tying multiple accounts in one polygon; Stacked as indicating whether polygon contains multiple accounts.

Official earlier GIS help says the Parcels shapefile contains polygons for every real-property parcel and describes HCAD_NUM as unique 13-digit real-property account number. The older CONDO_FLAG describes stacked duplicates for condos, undivided interest and pure accounts.
Current live layer metadata confirms HCAD_NUM has a non-unique index, OBJECTID is a unique service-row identifier, no GlobalID is available, and geometry is native WKID 102740 / EPSG:2278.

latestAttempt.conclusion: The seven account groups are not arbitrary conflicts: four distinct non-overlapping components and three exact duplicate copies, all sharing acct_num. HCAD_NUM remains the official account-level unit. Runtime retainParcel checks exact geometry equality before its optional disjointParts intersection check, so identical copies deduplicate; set disjointParts=true to reject any non-identical overlapping components. Use acct_num as the sole invariant partMatchField. Exclude the two records without any HCAD account key using attributeNotNull on HCAD_NUM.
latestAttempt.earlyGateAssessment: Likely to pass early identity and geometry acceptance with the descriptor above. Full bounded 18-cell and exact-ID runtime gate remains coordinator work.
